Odisha BJP MP's daughter's social media post sparks party ire

The daughter of an Odisha BJP MP posted on social media celebrating the resignation of Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. The post, which included the phrase "Don't bother, I won't delete," reportedly sparked ire within the party. The daughter identified herself as "Gen Z" in her post.
